_meta.question: relation_only repair
_meta.population: every row in the top 2,000 of every course whose definition reads as a bare grammatical relation, on the rows production serves, using the predicate corrected in CHECKS §43: 3,072 rows across 22 courses
_meta.method: in-session maker-checker (Workflow tool, no API key): one agent per 40 rows rewriting into the house shape (meaning first, relation in parentheses, matching the FORM not the lemma), every rewrite re-judged by an independent checker for that language
_meta.result: relation_only inside the band fell from 3,072 to 154
_meta.verification: maker-checker, NOT human-reviewed (quality rule 30), plus mechanical gates in scripts/apply_relation_only_fixes.py — the decisive one being that a rewrite still tripping is_relation_only is refused as not-a-repair
